  private useStyleBodyRow(swing: { t: number; dur: number; useStyle?: number; aim?: number }, p: Player): number {

    const pAnim = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, swing.t / swing.dur));
    switch (us) {
      case 1:
      case 13:
        // :35882-35890 / :35971-35985：三段 行1/2/3（13 与 1 同表）

      case 6: {
        // :35931-35947：(1-pAnim)*6 截 1，≥0.5 → 行3 否则行2

      }
      case 5: {
        // :35986-36011：默认行3；itemRotation*dir < -0.75 → 行2、> 0.6 → 行4。
        // itemRotation = Atan2(aimY*dir, aimX*dir)（:46730）——朝左时与裸 aim 相差 ±π，
        // 此前直接 aim*facing 同源错位。gravDir=-1 行2↔4 互换（:35996-36011）
        const irot = Math.atan2(Math.sin(swing.aim ?? 0) * p.facing, Math.cos(swing.aim ?? 0) * p.facing);
        const n21 = irot * p.facing;
        if (p.gravDir === -1) {
          if (n21 < -0.75) return 4;
          if (n21 > 0.6) return 2;
          return 3;

        return 3;

// 实体基类与分桶管理器
import type { GameHooks } from './types';
import type { Camera } from '../render/Camera';
import type { Renderer } from '../render/Renderer';

export abstract class Entity {
  id = 0;
  x = 0; y = 0;          // 左上角 px
  w = 16; h = 16;
  vx = 0; vy = 0;
  dead = false;
  onGround = false;
  hitWall = false;
  hitHead = false;
  /** 原版 collideY（NPC.cs:93804）：本轴 tile 碰撞改写 vy（TileCollision 层、
   *  slopeCollide 之前——坡面贴合清零不置位）。moveAndCollide 逐 tick 写/复位；
   *  消费点 Enemy.slimeAI 携物梯（:61309 气球弹跳 / :61932/:62124 落地嵌固回退） */
  collideY = false;
  dropThrough = false;
  /** 液体位移减速因子（原版 waterMovementSpeed 族，NPC.cs:5946 默认 水/岩浆 .5、
   *  蜂蜜 .25、微光 .375）。1=dry 不减速；Enemy 侧 npcLiquid.updateNpcLiquid 每 tick 写，
   *  moveAndCollide 入口缩 dx/dy（velocity 不变——同 Collision_MoveWhileWet :93986） */
  liqFactor = 1;
  // ---- 联机傀儡标记（v3 实体同步）：快照驱动实体，本地不跑 AI/命中判定 ----
  netPuppet = false;
  /** 联机实体号（拥有者 slot 高 8 位 + 本地 id 低 24 位；见 net/entitySyncHooks） */
  netId = 0;
  // ---- P3.2 傀儡插值缓冲（15Hz 快照 × 60TPS 渲染的平滑桥）----
  /** 最新权威快照位（NPC 接触判定用；弹幕侧判定用渲染位——见 Game 两处接触注释） */
  netAx = 0; netAy = 0;
  /** 插值起点（快照到达时的渲染位）与进度（1=已到目标，纯外推） */
  netIx = 0; netIy = 0; netIt = 1;
  private netSnapIvt = 4;

  abstract fixedUpdate(dt: number, game: GameHooks): void;
  abstract draw(r: Renderer, cam: Camera): void;

  /** 快照到达（Game.netApplyNpcSnaps / netApplyProjSnaps 调用）：设插值目标。
   *  从当前渲染位连续出发（中途到包不跳变）；intervalTicks = 快照周期（15Hz=4 tick） */
  netSnapTo(x: number, y: number, intervalTicks = 4) {
    this.netIx = this.x; this.netIy = this.y;
    this.netAx = x; this.netAy = y;
    this.netIt = 0;
    this.netSnapIvt = Math.max(1, intervalTicks);
  }

  /** 傀儡每 tick 推进：未到目标走 smoothstep 插值（一个快照周期到达），到后纯速度外推 */
  netPuppetStep() {
    if (this.netIt < 1) {
      this.netIt = Math.min(1, this.netIt + 1 / this.netSnapIvt);
      const t = this.netIt * this.netIt * (3 - 2 * this.netIt); // smoothstep
      this.x = this.netIx + (this.netAx - this.netIx) * t;
      this.y = this.netIy + (this.netAy - this.netIy) * t;
      return;
    }
    this.x += this.vx;
    this.y += this.vy;
  }

  get cx() { return this.x + this.w / 2; }
  get cy() { return this.y + this.h / 2; }
  aabbOverlaps(o: Entity): boolean {
    return this.x < o.x + o.w && this.x + this.w > o.x && this.y < o.y + o.h && this.y + this.h > o.y;
  }
}

/** 就地剔除 dead 实体(保持顺序,零分配)。带 destroy() 的实体(如 GrenadeProj
 *  的引信循环音句柄)在剔除时清理——fixedUpdate 早退分支已自行调用,此处兜底 */
function compact(list: Entity[]): void {
  let w = 0;
  for (let r = 0; r < list.length; r++) {
    const e = list[r];
    if (!e.dead) { list[w++] = e; continue; }
    (e as { destroy?: () => void }).destroy?.();
  }
  list.length = w;
}

isRopeAt(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const k = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!(st.flags[k] & 1)) return false;          // !active
  const def = TILE_DEFS[st.type[k]];
  if (!def) return false;
  if (def.rope) return true;                     // Main.tileRope（Main.cs:9223-9227:213/214/353/365/366）
  const sheet = def.vanilla?.sheet;
  if (sheet !== 314 && sheet !== 380 && !VANILLA_PLATFORM_SHEETS.has(sheet)) return false;
  // GetRopeEnds（WorldGen.cs:70069-70105,treatEmptyAsTheRopeEnd=false,range 5）
  let topRopeY = -1;
  for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
    const ty = y - i;
    if (!st.inBounds(x, ty)) break;              // InWorld
    const kk = st.idx(x, ty);
    if (!(st.flags[kk] & 1)) break;              // !active → break（不置 topRopeY）
    if (TILE_DEFS[st.type[kk]]?.rope) { topRopeY = ty; break; }
  }
  let bottomRopeY = -1;
  for (let j = 1 + (y - topRopeY); j <= 6; j++) {
    const ty = topRopeY + j;
    if (!st.inBounds(x, ty)) break;
    const kk = st.idx(x, ty);
    if (!(st.flags[kk] & 1)) break;
    if (TILE_DEFS[st.type[kk]]?.rope) { bottomRopeY = ty; break; }
  }
  return topRopeY !== -1 && bottomRopeY !== -1;
}

/** Collision.SolidCollision（Collision.cs:2713-2746）：盒与实心非平台格相交判定
 *  (扫描域扩 ±1/+2 格;halfBrick 只算下半 8px) */
solidCollision(st: TileStore, px: number, py: number): boolean {
  const x0 = Math.floor(px / TILE) - 1;
  let x1 = Math.floor((px + this.w) / TILE) + 2;
  const y0 = Math.floor(py / TILE) - 1;
  let y1 = Math.floor((py + this.h) / TILE) + 2;
  for (let i = x0; i <= x1; i++) {
    for (let j = y0; j <= y1; j++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;
      const k = st.idx(i, j);
      const def = TILE_DEFS[st.type[k]];
      // tileSolid && !tileSolidTop（:2728)——repo platform 旗=tileSolidTop 表
      if (!def?.solid || def.platform) continue;
      if (st.wire[k] & TileStore.WIRE_ACTUATED) continue;   // !inActive()
      let ty = j * TILE, th = TILE;
      if (st.half[k]) { ty += 8; th -= 8; }                 // halfBrick:下半实心
      if (px + this.w > i * TILE && px < i * TILE + TILE && py + this.h > ty && py < ty + th) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
```

```ts
/** RotatedRelativePoint（Player.cs:4063-4089）。sleeping/sitting 偏移支未移植
 *  （本仓睡/坐态 gfxOffY 恒 0 且与线锚消费互斥;登记）。rotation 参数 = 本仓

rotatedRelativePoint(px: number, py: number,
  opts: { reverseRotation?: boolean; addGfxOffY?: boolean; rotation?: number } = {},
): { x: number; y: number } {
  const rotation = opts.rotation ?? this.anchorFullRotation;
  const rot = opts.reverseRotation ? -rotation : rotation;         // :4065
  const cos = Math.cos(rot), sin = Math.sin(rot);
  const pivX = this.x + this.w / 2;                                // Bottom.X
  const pivY = this.y + this.h + this.gfxOffY;                     // :4070 Bottom+(0,gfxOffY)
  const po = this.mount.active ? this.mount.playerOffset : 0;
  const num2 = Math.floor(po / 2) + 4;                             // :4071 PlayerOffset/2+4

  if (opts.addGfxOffY !== false) y += this.gfxOffY;                // :4073-4076
  const dx = px - pivX, dy = y - pivY;
  return {
    x: pivX + dx * cos - dy * sin + -num2 * sin,                   // :4072 vector2.X
    y: pivY + dx * sin + dy * cos + -num2 + num2 * cos,            // :4072 vector2.Y
  };
}

                        // 玻璃钢钓竿（fishingPole=5）\n    p.facing = 1;\n    expect(p.applyItemPositionOffsetFromMount(100, 200, { itemAnimating: true }))\n      .toEqual({ x: 98, y: 200 });\n    p.facing = -1;\n    expect(p.applyItemPositionOffsetFromMount(100, 200, { itemAnimating: true }))\n      .toEqual({ x: 102, y: 200 });\n  });\n\n  it('非动画且无 holdStyle → 早退零偏移（:50649-50652）；非表坐骑恒零（:50667）', () => {\n    const p = mkPlayer(100, 200);\n    ride(p, 54);\n    hold(p, 3278);\n    expect(p.applyItemPositionOffsetFromMount(100, 200)).toEqual({ x: 100, y: 200 });\n    p.useTime = 8;   // 171：原版同款双计行为\n  });\n\n  it('骑迅猛龙持钓竿（动画中）：起点 ≠ 裸中心（mount54 (−2,0) 档生效）', () => {\n    const p = mkPlayer(100, 200);\n    ride(p, 54);\n    hold(p, 2289);\n    p.facing = 1;\n    p.useTime = 8;                          // itemAnimation>0（8t 抛竿窗）\n    const t = fishingPoleTipStart(p, 2289);\n    expect(t).toEqual({ x: 153 - 2, y: 185 });\n    expect(t.x).not.toBe(110 + 43);
